text:
kevin: FYI Peregrine AI (acct PRG-501) just hit 72 days overdue on INV-2025-622 ($62,400). CFO emailed asking for a short-term credit for anomalous spike and to split remaining balance over 4 months. cc @anya @tom

anya: any active disputes or tickets? I see a usage spike in Apr but nothing flagged as a support-originated outage.

kevin: customer claims a webhook duplication caused a surge; they want $15k credit applied to this invoice and then a 4-month amortization for the rest.

tom: Collections POV: we usually require incident ticket + proof before applying credits. also prefer ACH for schedules; card token can be accepted but more risk.

omkar: Finance here / Omkar: okay to consider a one-time operational credit up to $15k if Ops/Support confirm duplicated writes and we get signed PA. require 20% upfront of post-credit balance, and a signed ACH mandate. Any credit will be non-refundable and documented.

sales-bot: Sales forwarded CFO note: "we can accept terms if you confirm credit and keep service live during payment plan." attached acceptance screenshot to #customer-docs.

kevin: draft proposal: apply $15,000 credit, new outstanding = $47,400. Upfront 20% of 47,400 = $9,480 due within 5 business days of PA. Remaining split into 3 equal monthly payments of $12,640 each. waive one-time admin fee if PA signed and first payment lands on time.

billing-bot: please create invoice revision, apply credit after Support confirmation, and attach PA template.

billing-bot: Created INV-2025-622.rev3. New provisional balance after proposed credit: $47,400. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2025-622/rev3 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Hold placed on escalation and service suspension for PRG-501 while PA and Ops verification pending. Reminder scheduled in 8 days.

anya: Ops to validate duplication event and confirm whether customer opened a support ticket. If Ops can't verify, we deny the credit and offer standard split only.

legal-bot: Legal note: include clause to reinstate collections and reserve termination rights if customer misses any scheduled payment. Also include dispute window of 10 business days for charges after auto-charge.

omkar: I'll approve the conditional credit and payment schedule subject to: 1) Ops confirmation of duplicate webhook, 2) signed PA, 3) ACH mandate or card token captured, 4) trade desk approval for >$10k credits logged. Omkar final sign-off after we see the 20% txn id.

kevin: CS has screenshot of CFO acceptance; sending PA and revised invoice now. I'll ask Sales to capture ACH mandate and upload to #customer-docs. If no signed PA + payment in 7 business days, we'll remove hold and resume standard collections. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sales-bot: Note added to CRM: "PA sent; CFO accepted verbally; ACH capture pending."

kevin: one more ask  can billing set tiered reminders (3 days before each installment + on due date)? helps reduce churn and collections overhead.

billing-bot: Reminder schedule queued: 3 days prior, due date, 2 days past due. Auto-charge enabled once token captured.

tom: +1 from collections. we'll monitor retry attempts and escalate after 2 failed auto-charges. Omkar to confirm final waiver of admin fee once upfront clears.

omkar: confirm conditional waiver of admin fee. final sign-off after 20% posts.

kevin: thanks team. I'll update this thread when Ops confirms duplication and when we get the txn id. :pray:
